demographics.trauma_type: Accidentally caused serious injury to another

vignette: Case Vignette for Javier Javier, a 22-year-old HVAC technician of Latin American descent, has been navigating the aftermath of an incident that occurred just over six months ago. At the time, he was working on a job at a high-rise building in downtown Los Angeles. The day started like any other; he arrived early, double-checked his tools, and made sure to communicate with his crew leader about the tasks ahead. The accident happened during what should have been routine maintenance work. Javier had climbed onto the roof of the building to check on some equipment when a colleague, Marco, followed him up to assist. As they were discussing their plan of action, Javier reached for a wrench that was sitting precariously close to the edge of the roof. Without thinking, he grabbed it, but in doing so, he inadvertently dislodged Marco's footing, causing him to lose his balance and fall over the side. Javier’s world froze as he watched Marco tumble from the rooftop, hitting each level on the way down before coming to a stop on the ground below. The sound of impact echoed through Javier’s ears, and he felt like time itself had stopped. He immediately called for help and waited anxiously until emergency responders arrived, but it was clear that Marco was critically injured. Since the incident, Javier has been experiencing profound guilt and anxiety. He constantly replays the moment in his mind, questioning whether he could have done something differently to prevent what happened. The thought of going back to work on rooftops is unbearable; every time he thinks about being at a high elevation, his heart races, and he breaks out into a cold sweat. Javier’s sleep has been severely disrupted since the accident. He wakes up multiple times each night, often finding himself paralyzed with fear as vivid nightmares replay Marco falling off the roof. In the mornings, he feels exhausted and emotionally drained, which affects both his work performance and his mood throughout the day. On a typical workday, Javier finds it challenging to concentrate on simple tasks. His mind wanders back to that fateful rooftop, and he becomes distracted by thoughts of what might have been different if only he had acted differently or taken more precautions. This difficulty in concentrating has led to mistakes on the job—like forgetting tools at a worksite—which adds to his sense of incompetence. Javier’s social life has also suffered since the accident. He used to enjoy spending time with friends, playing soccer, and attending family gatherings. Now, he often avoids these activities out of fear that something similar might happen again, or that he won't be able to handle the stress of being around others who might judge him for what happened. He has become increasingly withdrawn, preferring solitude over social interaction. Even simple tasks like driving or walking by a building with multiple stories can trigger intense feelings of anxiety and guilt. Javier finds himself constantly checking his surroundings for potential hazards, as if he’s always on high alert to prevent another accident from occurring. Despite these challenges, Javier remains committed to his job as an HVAC technician because it provides him with structure and a sense of purpose, even though it is difficult at times. He continues to go through the motions of his work but struggles with the emotional toll it takes each day. Javier often wonders if he will ever be able to reconcile what happened and move past this incident. His friends have noticed changes in his behavior, noting that he seems distant and preoccupied. They have tried to offer support, but Javier finds it hard to open up about his feelings because he fears they might judge him for what he did. As a result, he has become increasingly isolated, carrying the burden of his trauma alone. Javier's experience is marked by intrusive memories, hypervigilance, avoidance behaviors, and significant emotional distress—symptoms that have deeply impacted his daily life and relationships. Despite these challenges, Javier continues to seek ways to cope and heal, hoping for a path towards recovery and peace with his past.
